utility.zh: 公用事業（水、電、瓦斯）；（utilities）水電費

ex.en: Does the rent include utilities?
ex.zh: 房租有含水電費嗎？

ex.en: The utility bill was higher this month.
ex.zh: 這個月的水電帳單比較高。

utility.en: a service such as water, electricity or gas, or the bill for it

ex.en: This utility can help you recover deleted files.
ex.zh: 這個工具程式可以幫你救回刪除的檔案。

ex.en: The new app has little practical utility.
ex.zh: 這個新 app 沒什麼實用價值。

utility.en: a small computer program that does a useful job, or the quality of being practical

ex.en: Tom utilized some wooden chests as chairs.
ex.zh: 湯姆拿幾個木箱當椅子用。

ex.en: We need to utilize our resources more efficiently.
ex.zh: 我們需要更有效率地運用資源。

ex.en: The new system is fully utilized by all departments.
ex.zh: 各部門都充分使用新系統。

utilize.en: to use something for a purpose

ex.en: We need to improve the utilization of our resources.
ex.zh: 我們需要提升資源的利用率。

ex.en: Machine utilization rose to 90 percent this quarter.
ex.zh: 本季機器使用率提高到九成。

utilization.en: the act of using something, or how much of it is in use

ex.en: The child's first utterance was "mama."
ex.zh: 這孩子說出的第一句話是「媽媽」。

ex.en: Each utterance was recorded for later analysis.
ex.zh: 每一句話都被錄下來供之後分析。

ex.en: She was too shocked to give utterance to her feelings.
ex.zh: 她震驚到說不出自己的感受。

ex.en: His careful utterance made the speech easy to follow.
ex.zh: 他說話字字清楚，演講很容易聽懂。

utterance.en: the act of speaking or showing feelings in words

utilities.zh: 水電瓦斯（等公共事業費用）

ex.en: The rent is 15,000 a month, not including utilities.
ex.zh: 房租每月一萬五，不含水電瓦斯。

ex.en: Utilities are usually paid by the tenant.
ex.zh: 水電瓦斯費通常由房客支付。

utilities.en: the services of water, electricity and gas, or the money paid for them

ex.en: This is a matter of the utmost importance.
ex.zh: 這件事至關重要。

ex.en: Patient privacy is treated with the utmost care at this clinic.
ex.zh: 這間診所以最謹慎的態度保護病人隱私。

ex.en: The doctors did their utmost to save the boy's life.
ex.zh: 醫生們盡全力搶救那個男孩的性命。

ex.en: I will try my utmost to finish the report on time.
ex.zh: 我會盡最大努力準時完成報告。

utmost.en: the greatest effort or amount possible

ex.en: I was utterly tired after the exam.
ex.zh: 考完試我整個人累壞了。

ex.en: The plan failed utterly.
ex.zh: 這個計畫徹底失敗了。

ex.en: She was utterly surprised by the gift.
ex.zh: 她對這份禮物感到非常驚訝。

ex.en: The room was in utter darkness.
ex.zh: 房間裡一片漆黑。

ex.en: His idea was an utter failure.
ex.zh: 他的點子徹底失敗了。

ex.en: I felt utter joy when I saw my family at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場看到家人時，感到無比的喜悅。

ex.en: He was so shocked that he could not utter a word.
ex.zh: 他太震驚了，一個字也說不出來。

ex.en: The baby uttered a small cry and fell asleep.
ex.zh: 寶寶發出一聲輕輕的哭聲，然後睡著了。

ex.en: We should utilise the space under the stairs for storage.
ex.zh: 我們應該利用樓梯下的空間來收納。

ex.en: Teachers can utilise videos to make lessons more fun.
ex.zh: 老師可以運用影片讓課程更有趣。

ex.en: He had a utopian dream of a world without poverty.
ex.zh: 他夢想著一個沒有貧窮的烏托邦世界。

ex.en: Critics said the plan was too utopian to work in real life.
ex.zh: 批評者說這個計畫太理想化，在現實中行不通。

ex.en: The room has plain, utilitarian furniture.
ex.zh: 這個房間裡擺著樸素實用的家具。

ex.en: He takes a utilitarian view of education and values job skills.
ex.zh: 他對教育抱持功利主義的觀點，重視就業技能。

ex.en: The baby grows inside the mother's uterus.
ex.zh: 寶寶在母親的子宮內成長。

ex.en: The doctor explained how the uterus changes during pregnancy.
ex.zh: 醫生解釋了懷孕期間子宮會有什麼變化。

ex.en: A wooden spoon is a useful kitchen utensil.
ex.zh: 木湯匙是一種好用的廚房用具。

ex.en: Please wash every utensil after you finish cooking.
ex.zh: 煮完飯後，請把每件器具都洗乾淨。

ex.en: The writer imagined a utopia without poverty.
ex.zh: 作者想像了一個沒有貧窮的烏托邦。

ex.en: No country is a perfect utopia.
ex.zh: 沒有任何一個國家是完美的理想國。

ex.en: Better utilisation of space made the office feel bigger.
ex.zh: 更有效地利用空間，讓辦公室感覺更大。

ex.en: The utilisation of solar energy is growing quickly.
ex.zh: 太陽能的利用正在快速增加。

ex.en: Utah is known for its red rock deserts and national parks.
ex.zh: 猶他州以紅岩沙漠與國家公園聞名。

ex.en: We drove across Utah on our way to the west coast.
ex.zh: 我們開車穿越猶他州前往西岸。

ex.en: The doctor explained the causes of uterine pain.
ex.zh: 醫生說明了子宮疼痛的原因。

ex.en: She had a check-up for a uterine condition last spring.
ex.zh: 她去年春天因為子宮方面的問題做了檢查。
